summary: commonweb-flow redirects dependency resolution to non-registry host with install script enabled
details: package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json redirect the sole dependency `linker-event-header-serial` to a tarball URL at `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial` instead of resolving it from the npm registry. The shrinkwrap entry for that dependency sets `hasInstallScript: true`, so on `npm install` npm downloads the tarball from `artifacts.yosiroute.com` and runs its lifecycle scripts on the installer's machine. Whoever controls `artifacts.yosiroute.com` can serve arbitrary bytes that execute at install time under the installer's account. The published `commonweb-flow` tarball is otherwise a near-empty stub, consistent with a lure package whose only effect is to pull attacker-controlled code from a non-registry host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
